name: Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Splatting
definition: A training-free, test-time plugin for Gaussian Splatting that applies 2D scale-adaptive filters to each Gaussian to improve anti-aliasing performance by matching Gaussian scales to testing frequency.
summary: Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Splatting is a training-free plugin that improves anti-aliasing by applying 2D filters informed by testing frequency, unlike methods unaware of sampling rates.
